info.name: api-onboarding Account Usage Funding API
info.description: Find funding accounts that can be used to settle and collect funds in each available currency.

query.description: The type of SSI to be returned, priority (Swift) or regular (local). A null value returns all payment types. (This can only be one of priority,regular)
(Required) The currency of the account details required, ISO 4217 standard.
UUID of a specific sub-account you want to see the SSIs for.
A contact UUID for the sub-account you're acting on behalf of.
Page number
Number of results per page.
Any field name to change the sort order.
Sort records in ascending or descending order. (This can only be one of asc,desc)
